capabilities: Create trip, day-plan, stop and activity notes from configurable templates with dates and links filled in
Drag day plans, stops and activities across days in an itinerary tab with undo
Customize note kinds, templates, save paths and form fields in settings
Plan trips from the command line via Obsidian CLI commands and an agent skill
Review and fix notes that can't be matched to a kind or trip
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or later; flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Works offline with no account; CLI commands require Obsidian running with the vault open.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to structure multi-day trip planning, where days, stops and activities are linked notes with their own dates.
summary: Trip planner that creates trip, day-plan, stop and activity notes from templates and lets you rearrange the itinerary in a dedicated tab.
